title: Admin override for onboarding checklist (Support/CS) + audit logging
author: Chloe Martin
body:
Context: Support/CS needs a safe way to mark checklist steps complete/reset during onboarding troubleshooting (e.g., customer rotated keys, telemetry backfill lag, or a step was missed due to earlier event-ordering issues). This PR adds admin-only override endpoints to the checklist progress service, plus audit logging and minimal UI plumbing for internal tools (Console will consume in a follow-up PR).

What’s included: (1) Admin override API endpoints to mark a checklist step COMPLETE/NOT_STARTED (or clear an override) for a tenant, with optional annotation text and an internal reason code; (2) Strict authorization (RBAC) so only Support/CS roles can call the endpoints, scoped to internal operators; (3) Immutable audit log entries capturing actor, tenant, step, previous state, new state, reason, and timestamp; (4) Telemetry events for override actions (PII-free) so we can monitor frequency and identify systemic onboarding issues; (5) Guardrails: overrides are additive on top of event-derived state and never delete raw events; step state transitions remain monotonic unless an override explicitly resets.

Why: Dogfood surfaced that a small number of tenants get “stuck” when event emission is delayed or the customer changes org structure. Support currently uses ad-hoc SQL/scripts to unblock customers; this creates risk and lacks auditability. We want an approved, logged, least-privilege path.

API summary: POST /internal/admin/onboarding/checklist/tenants/{tenant_id}/steps/{step_id}:override with body {"action": "MARK_COMPLETE"|"RESET"|"CLEAR_OVERRIDE", "reason_code": "AUTH_ROTATION"|"TELEMETRY_DELAY"|"CUSTOMER_CONFIRMED"|"OTHER", "note": "freeform"}. GET /internal/admin/onboarding/checklist/tenants/{tenant_id}/audit returns latest override actions (paginated).

Permissions: New RBAC permission "support:checklist_override" (role-bound to Support + CS internal roles). Requests require an operator identity (no API keys) and are denied for customer principals.

Audit retention: Audit records follow existing admin-action retention (18 months) and are excluded from customer-accessible logs. Notes are limited to 500 chars and should not contain customer secrets/PII.

Testing: Unit tests for authorization, idempotency, and audit writes; integration tests for typical override flows; added data-contract test to ensure override telemetry payload stays within cardinality constraints.

Follow-ups: (a) Console UI admin drawer + Support macro deep links (tracked in ENG-5852 subtask); (b) Add a “reason required” enforcement in UI for RESET actions; (c) Consider restricting RESET to a smaller set of steps if we see misuse.
commits: checklist-progress: add admin override handler + service methods
rbac: add support:checklist_override permission + policy bindings
db: add checklist_step_overrides and checklist_override_audit tables
tests: authz + override idempotency + audit log assertions
review_conversation: Dev Patel (Support): Can we make sure Support can see who did the override + why? We need it for ticket notes. Also please add guidance that notes should not include API keys or customer secrets.

Chloe Martin (Author): Added GET /audit endpoint returning actor + reason_code + note + timestamps. Also added docs/internal/support/checklist-admin-overrides.md with a “no secrets/PII” section and note length limit (500 chars).
Logan Wright (Telemetry): Please ensure the override telemetry event does not include freeform note text (cardinality + privacy). Also confirm we’re using server-side emission only.
Chloe Martin (Author): Updated telemetry to emit reason_code + action + step_id only. No notes included. Event is emitted server-side from checklist-progress on successful write.

Kaitlyn Nguyen (Platform/Auth): RBAC: please confirm this can’t be called with customer API keys, and that operator identity is enforced. Also prefer explicit permission instead of reusing broad admin.

Chloe Martin (Author): Enforced operator auth via internal auth middleware; customer principals are rejected. Added new permission support:checklist_override and bound it to Support/CS internal roles only.

Marcus Lin (Security): Audit log retention/visibility: please confirm audit entries are internal-only and follow existing admin-action retention. Also add a guardrail preventing notes from including obvious secrets (optional).

Chloe Martin (Author): Confirmed internal-only; retention aligns with admin-action policy (18 months). Added basic note validation (reject if it matches common key patterns) and a warning in the internal doc.
Dylan Brooks (Console): One concern: progress state precedence. If an override marks COMPLETE and later events arrive, do we keep COMPLETE? If an override resets, can the step re-complete via events?

Chloe Martin (Author): Precedence is: explicit override wins when present. CLEAR_OVERRIDE returns to event-derived. RESET sets override=NOT_STARTED; if later events indicate completion, we keep NOT_STARTED until CLEAR_OVERRIDE to avoid surprising Support mid-debug. Added tests and inline docs in progress_state.ts.
Logan Wright (Telemetry): Approved after schema changes. Thanks for keeping payload tight.
Dev Patel (Support): Approved. This unblocks the macro flow we discussed in INT-3307.
Marcus Lin (Security): Approved with note validation + doc updates.
release_notes: Internal-only: adds Support/CS admin override endpoints for onboarding checklist steps with audit logging and RBAC permission support:checklist_override. No customer-facing behavior changes unless Support applies an override.
timeline: 2025-03-26: PR opened by Chloe Martin; linked ENG-5852 and INT-3307
2025-03-27: Requested changes addressed (telemetry payload tightened, audit endpoint added, RBAC permission added)
2025-03-28: All checks green; approvals from Support, Telemetry, Auth, Security; merged to main
